humanSource: Quoted from the library documentation, discipline/trust-ladder and caveats.
label: registered
limitation: The ladder is a ceiling on overclaiming, not a source of truth, and it is worth being exact about its limits, because a discipline that oversells itself is just a new way to be wrong.
scope: The level is never set by a caller. It is computed from whether the evidence carries a calibration reference, whether it was produced under a frozen study, and whether it survived its kill criteria. There is no setter and no back door. If you want a higher rung, you have to make a truer fact.
statement: The claim was frozen before the run. A study spec, with its predictions, was content-hashed and git-stamped, so the result is adjudicated against a prediction that provably predates the data.
